verified_scope.claim: The E7.5-start cohort was cultured from E7.5 to a maximum reported morphology of approximately E12.5 after 5.5 culture days; about 48-49 somites and Theiler stage 20.
Embryos retaining an intact yolk sac did not develop beyond culture day 5. The additional ~12 hours used opened yolk sac tissue while preserving umbilical vascular continuity.

The authors report approximately 10-20% proper morphological development at 5.5 culture days across mouse strains; Figure 1D states that embryo and independent-experiment denominators are plotted, but exact values were not transcribed here.
verified_scope.locator: Results, printed lines 171-186; Figure 1 caption, PDF page 22, lines 681-684.

verified_scope.claim: At day 5.5 the authors report enlarged heart, pericardial edema, internal hemorrhage and necrosis of internal tissues, with their oxygen/nutrient explanation preserved as an author-attributed mechanism.

The separate E6.5-start cohort reached approximately E11.75 after six culture days; the final day was reported at 12-18% proper morphology, with a 4-6 somite developmental delay. It is not pooled with E7.5-start embryos.
The paper reports ex-vivo ovarian development from isolated cultured-embryo gonads to secondary follicles, but not a whole cultured embryo live birth or same-animal postnatal follow-up.

limits: Morphological normality is the paper-defined scoring outcome, not a comprehensive healthy-output or later-life assessment.
The reported stage extension beyond day 5 involves opening yolk sac tissue; continuity is vascularly maintained but the intact-yolk-sac configuration is not.
Metabolic maternal/placental independence does not establish independence of all developmental support functions.
The preprint and mouse data do not establish human ectogenesis or complete gestation.

Exact per-experiment normal embryo numerators, raw percentages/source tables and unit-linked attrition remain unreported in the inspected figure labels; the 46 denominator pairs only describe assessment coverage by timepoint/platform.
